stories.title: This day in Juventus history: The night the Bianconeri core conquered Wembley
stories.summary: On Nov 14, 1973, Zoff, Capello, Spinosi, and Causio led Italy to its first-ever win at Wembley. Wembley Stadium was not a place where visiting sides arrived expecting to leave with much to celebrate. England had conquered the world on that very pitch in 1966, and although their reign as world champions had ended in Mexico four years later, Wembley remained one of football's most imposing stages. By November 1973, England were also coming to terms with the disappointment of failing to qualify for the following summer's World Cup. Italy, meanwhile, had an opportunity to accomplish something they had never managed before: defeat England on English soil.
